title: Predicting antimicrobial resistance in Pseudomonas aeruginosa with machine learning-enabled molecular diagnostics.
summary: Across 414 clinical Pseudomonas aeruginosa isolates, genomic/transcriptomic/phenotypic ML identified marker combinations predicting resistance to four antibiotic classes; transcriptomics improved predictions over genome alone and included previously unassociated markers. External replication and prospective utility were not established in the reviewed material.
ai_technology: ML integrates gene presence, sequence variation and expression profiles to predict antimicrobial resistance.
